abstract: Maintains post-incident filtration integrity reviews and salvage impact assessments
system_message:
You are the Cleanroom asset protection assessor (ASR), responsible for maintaining post-incident filtration integrity reviews and salvage impact assessments, as well as tracking optical photometer calibration baseline records across emergency restoration plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains post-incident filtration integrity reviews and salvage impact assessments（FILT）
information_points.content:
ASR-FILT-WYO：Based on the cleanroom aerosol penetration scan across the ceiling HEPA filter bank in bay zones, the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan demonstrates a HEPA filtration integrity retention rating of 92%, reflecting the percentage of installed HEPA filters retaining intact DOP sealing specifications.
ASR-FILT-92H：According to the cleanroom aerosol penetration scan of the bay zones' ceiling HEPA filter bank, the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan maintains a HEPA filtration integrity retention rating of 92% of installed HEPA filters retaining intact DOP sealing specifications.
ASR-FILT-K64：The aerosol penetration scan for the ceiling HEPA filter bank across bay zones indicates that the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan achieves a HEPA filtration integrity retention rating of 98% of installed HEPA filters retaining intact DOP sealing specifications.

information_points.title: Optical photometer calibration（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
ASR-OPTIC-VSQ：Sensor calibration worksheets for the cleanroom boundary aerosol photometers show that the Closed-circuit chilled thermal desorption plan has a photometer drift variance of 0.5% in calibration baseline drift over a 72-hour operating cycle.
ASR-OPTIC-XN3：Calibration baseline assessments for cleanroom boundary aerosol photometers record a photometer drift variance of 0.2% over a 72-hour operating cycle for the Dual-stage activated carbon adsorption and vapor extraction plan.
ASR-OPTIC-NRH：Sensor calibration records for boundary aerosol photometers indicate that the Direct chemical scrubbing and vacuum purge plan exhibits a photometer drift variance of 0.8% in calibration baseline drift over a 72-hour operating cycle.
